title: feat(nm2frm2lxr): neighbor-read of L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then -e1 at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Archetype of the band: existential 6-NN neighbour-read of the L-path (-e3 then -e1) on the two-axis opposite seed, with a full printed frame/Orient/P trace for all four probes. Reproduced exactly; the trace is where the band's central defect is visible, since every printed P is F_dst*F_src^T and therefore automatically a signed permutation with det = Orient*Orient.
